basis: Malignancy of the spermatic cord, a reproductive structure outside the specified axes.
Ventricular hypertrophy and hearing impairment define the cardioauditory syndrome.
Extraneural tumour typically occupying dermis/subcutis; neural differentiation does not establish nerve damage. [Series](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27845943/)
Inherited podocyte disease causing nephrotic syndrome; no evidence of an immune-mediated mechanism or substantial extrarenal damage.
Thymic epithelial malignancy; thymus is outside the specified anatomical axes. Thymoma alone is neither lymphoma nor an immune-mediated disease.
Congenital upper-lip nodule; lip and mouth fall within the gastrointestinal axis.
Malignancy occupying the choroid, ciliary body or iris.
Hypophosphatemic rickets with defining renal proximal tubular dysfunction and phosphate wasting; defective bone mineralization is intrinsic.
Defining ventriculomegaly and congenital joint contractures; cerebellar and callosal malformations reinforce neurologic involvement.
Familial dilated cardiomyopathy with severe ventricular dysfunction; reported additional defects are also cardiovascular.
Most lesions are subcutaneous soft-tissue masses; metaplastic bone within the tumour does not establish a primary bone disorder.
Degenerative disease of the hand joints.
SPAST-related central motor pathway disease, including spastic paraplegia and complex neurologic phenotypes.
Structural skeletal myopathy; ophthalmoparesis in 1/1 and ptosis in 1/2 support ocular motor involvement, although the reported cohort is very small.
Defining ocular, branchial skin and lip/dental defects; conductive hearing impairment 80-99%. Renal malformations are occasional (<30%).
Most patients across this umbrella have lung-origin carcinoma. Neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine-gland disease; metastatic sites vary.
Inherited ventricular septal defect; associated septal and great-vessel abnormalities remain within the cardiovascular axis.
Developmental bone disorder with generalized metaphyseal enchondromas.
Congenital duplication of skeletal structures of the great toe.
Umbrella for disorders arising in immunodeficiency; no anatomical organ is consistently affected across its heterogeneous members.
Marrow failure, retinopathy and nail/skin dystrophy define disease; neurodevelopmental delay 30-79%, cerebellar hypoplasia 2/2. Oral leukoplakia 2/2 omitted by cap.
Neoplasm arising in the uterine corpus; reproductive organs have no axis, regardless of epithelial or mesenchymal differentiation.
Congenital structural defect of the lower eyelid; associated facial clefting is not universal.
Neurologic movement disorder defined by motor and vocal tics; neurotransmitter abnormalities do not establish a separate metabolic disorder.
Defining AVMs affect medial forebrain and nose; pituitary dysfunction is not established as common. [Orphanet](https://www.orpha.net/en/disease/detail/141189)
